text: 2026-08-03 run-scoped hypothesis slice: StructuralTContrast and StructuralFContrast now compile against RunwiseDesignSlice and evaluate against a selected run, preserving axis/fingerprint checks. DesignSchema.runwiseSlice defaults to RowLayout.selectedRows and accepts an explicit typed ScanIndex selection for censoring/response subsets. ChunkedRunwiseExecutionScenarioSuite now exercises censored row selection, run-one/run-two semantic T and F evaluation, and rejects applying a run-one hypothesis to run two; design and fit tests pass on JVM+JS. Mixed-TR acceptance, cross-run hypotheses, and SeparateRunsThenFixedEffects remain open.
